remaining_concerns: The retained set is concentrated in nuclear signaling, New START, and Zaporizhzhia control; other Chapter 1B lenses are comparatively thin.
Several late-September items are repetitive follow-ups to the same threat episode, so the chapter remains somewhat speech-heavy.
Some context items are retrospective or institutional rather than direct 2022 Putin actions, which limits evidentiary independence.
